newsitem.title: FRANCE: Newspaper office bombed in Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Newspaper office bombed in Corsica.

text.p: A bomb blast rocked the Ajaccio office of the Corse-Matin daily newspaper early on Monday, causing slight damage and no injuries, police said.

No one immediately claimed responsibility for the blast on the Mediterranean resort island, which has been racked for more than two decades by separatist guerrillas seeking increased autonomy for the island from mainland France.
The newspaper, the Corsican edition of the regional daily Nice-Matin, has twice before been the target of bombing attacks.
